headline: Quarterly earnings per share rise on the year and quarter
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ₹5.62 versus ₹4.04 a year ago, up 39.1%, and up 118.7% from ₹2.57 in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ₹5.62 compares with ₹4.04 in the same quarter a year earlier and ₹2.57 last quarter. These are the only verified figures on file; a web search found only first-quarter results and year-ago comparatives, so revenue, EBITDA, drivers and guidance for this period are not reported.
